description: Call any lab product by id + op through one door. Args: product (required), op (required), plus op-specific fields. Fail-closed when the product or op is unknown or a live adapter is missing.

op.description: Operation for that product (e.g. card, receipt, draw).

product.description: Product id from spl_products (e.g. gitdepot, psi, conductor).

name: spl_product_call
